EmailTemplate.subject: A patient payment stat that amazed me – and what you can do about it
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
It’s rare to be able to get deep insight into what drives a patient to pay. A recent study of 3 thousand patients undertaken by PYMNTS.com set out to do just that.
What they found was truly amazing. The majority of patients paying at health systems are meeting their responsibility through payment plans. 44% of patients surveyed, who incurred out-of-pocket expenses, said they used a payment plan to pay their share of the cost. (7.1 percent said that they had not met their responsibility at all and had no intention of doing so).
The need for affordable options in healthcare is only getting louder. Flywire has been helping health systems match patients with affordable options to meet their needs for years.
If you’re looking to dive deeper into what drives patients to pay, the numbers tell the whole story.
